visual_action: The video is a split-screen. On the left panel, dated 'Jan 6, 2021', security camera footage shows a man in a suit, identified as Josh Hawley, running down a hallway inside a building, away from other people including law enforcement officers. A white spotlight effect follows him as he runs. On the right panel, dated 'Jul 22, 2022', Josh Hawley is shown speaking defiantly into a microphone on a stage.

cast.name: Josh Hawley
cast.evidence: He is identified via face recognition on the right side of the screen, where he is speaking. The video is about the contrast between his words and his actions, as shown in the footage on the left.

on_screen_text.text: And I am not backing down.
I'm not going to run from you.

spoken_summary: Josh Hawley says, "And I am not backing down. I'm not going to apologize. I'm not going to cower. I'm not going to run from you."
audio_music: The audio begins with only Josh Hawley's speaking voice. As he says the line "I'm not going to run from you," an upbeat, jaunty, comical piece of music begins and plays for the rest of the video. The music serves to mock the footage of him running, framing it as a silly chase scene.
editing_pacing: The video uses a static split-screen to juxtapose two clips. On the left, the footage of the man running is looped, and a spotlight effect is used to highlight him. The editing is simple and focuses on the direct contrast between the audio and the visual B-roll.
cultural_references: The comical chase music is from the Soviet/Russian animated series 'Nu, pogodi!' ('Well, Just You Wait!'), functioning similarly to the 'Benny Hill' theme to create a satirical effect.
central_claim: Josh Hawley's defiant words about not backing down or running are hypocritical, as shown by security footage of him running away during the January 6th Capitol attack.
intended_effect: To mock Josh Hawley, undermine his persona of strength, and portray him as a coward and a hypocrite.
